eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Johnson, WY; at 3:29 PM on AUG 22, 2024 Effective until 8:29 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: HOUSE DRAW FIRE UPDATE, residents north of I-90 from Tipperary Rd to northern and eastern county lines are being issued evac orders. For assistance contact dispatch at 307-217-1980. Bomber Mtn Center is open for evacuees.  Domestic animals are welcome with evacuees who must remain at shelter.  If animals need to be dropped off, contact JC Fairgrounds.
